INTVL turns every walk, run or bike ride into a game played on the real world globe. The idea is simple. When you run or ride in a loop, the ground inside that loop becomes your territory. The bigger, smarter and more tactical your routes, the more of the map you hold.

Claim your territory

Every loop you complete claims real space. Other players are out there doing the same thing, so the map is always moving. You can take a new route to take new ground, or go back over an area to defend what's already yours.

Play it your way

Some people want to be the best in the world, so they chase the global leaderboard. Others care more about home turf and work to become the territory leader of their own suburb or city. Both are worth playing for, and you can switch focus whenever you want.

Hold ground, win real prizes

Every bit of the map you hold earns you entries into our competitions, where the prizes are real. The more territory you hold at the end of the competition, the better your odds.

Run and ride with clubs

Join a club and play as a team. Your territory adds to your club's total, so a good capture from you helps everyone you're playing alongside.

A feed built around the game

INTVL has a social feed where you can follow other players, see their activities, and cheer them on. It's a good way to find people around you and stay connected to other athletes around the world.

Bring your own gear

INTVL works with the devices you already train on, so your activities sync straight into the game:
- Garmin
- Suunto
- Polar
- Coros
- Fitbit
- Hammerhead
- Wahoo

We built INTVL to give a new meaning to fitness. Movement without stakes is just exercise. The world is the game. Take it.

This app integrates with Apple Health (HealthKit) to show insights about your activity, including steps, heart rate, and previous runs.

Your Territory turns the walk you already take into a game for the map. You head out, the streets fill with your color, and every 50 x 50 m cell you step on becomes yours. No pace to hold, no distance to hit - just the route under your feet.

Not a running tracker. A map you take one step at a time.

CLAIM CELLS

The city is split into 50 x 50 m cells. Walk across a cell and you get full influence on it. Come back to your start point and close the loop, and the whole area inside is yours too, with a lighter "Ring" claim. Never made it back? Nothing is lost - the cells along your route still count.

EVERY CELL IS CONTESTED

No cell is yours forever. Ownership is your share of all players' influence on it: Strong (67-100%), Medium (33-66%), Weak (1-33%). A neighbor walks through a few times and the cell flips to them. When influence is split exactly evenly, the cell turns contested and goes gray on the map - a draw, until someone walks it again.

TERRITORY NEEDS ACTIVITY

A pass holds full strength for six months, half strength from six months to a year, and is gone after a year. Want to keep your neighborhood? Keep coming back.

COMPETITIONS

Build your own arena: a point on the map and a radius from 500 m to 20 km. Open arenas are found by every player nearby, closed ones only by invite code. Each arena has its own leaderboard, your rank in it, and your progress toward the leader. The owner moderates: kick, ban, or hand over ownership.

A LEADERBOARD FOR EVERY CELL

Tap any cell on the map and see the whole story: who is claiming it, how many passes each player has, when the last one was, what your strength is built from, and how much the competition takes away.

STATISTICS

Daily and weekly ownership dynamics: how much you captured, how much you lost, over a week, a month, or all time. Your personal territory and every competition, tracked separately. Plus your record area for a single walk.

YOUR WALK ON SCREEN

While recording you see area, distance, steps, time, GPS accuracy and how far you are from the start point. A Live Activity keeps the progress in the Dynamic Island and on the lock screen, so the phone can stay in your pocket.

FAIR PLAY

Built-in protection against faking: points with poor GPS do not count, suspicious jumps are discarded, and riding in a vehicle pauses the recording. The reason is always on screen, and your track survives it - walk back to the last point and recording picks up on its own.

WORKS ANYWHERE

Recording runs in the background without interruptions. No connection? The walk is saved and uploads itself once you are back online. You can also play locally without signing up - your territories then stay on this phone only.

MAKE IT YOURS

Light and dark theme, English and Russian, your own player color on the map, standard or satellite view, haptics on capture, and push notifications when territory is taken or lost in a competition.

Head outside. The map is empty - go take it.

Access Permission Guide

Location (required): recording your route, measuring area, claiming cells. "Always" access is needed so recording does not stop when the app is in the background. Motion & Fitness (recommended): step counting and vehicle detection for anti-cheat. Notifications (optional): territory captured or lost in your competitions.

Notes

GPS accuracy depends on your surroundings - dense buildings, trees and terrain affect the route and the area. Competitions, leaderboards and sync need a network connection. Walk recording works offline.

Territor.io turns a run into a land grab.

Close a loop on your route and the ground inside it becomes yours: painted in your color on a live map and worth points on the board. Run a bigger, smarter loop than your friends and you take theirs. Lost ground? Run it again and take it back.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start a run. Territor.io tracks it with GPS and keeps tracking with the screen off. (Continued use of GPS in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.)
• Close a loop: circle back to where you started, or cross your own path. Any shape that encloses ground counts.
• Finish to watch your captured area light up.
• Already running with your Apple Watch? Turn on Apple Fitness sync in Settings (iOS) to bring those runs in automatically. They show up in your history and can be published to claim territory, just like runs you record in the app.
• Publish when you're ready. Nothing is shared until you do.

IT'S A TURF WAR
The newest loop to enclose a patch owns it. Your territory is always up for grabs, and so is everyone else's — the map never stops moving.

BRING YOUR RIVALS
Create a private group, invite friends with a link, and share a map and leaderboard that belong only to you. Or publish to the Global game and take your place on the world board.

RULES THAT CHANGE THE GAME
Each group's season picks which rules it plays by:
• Conditions: a hard run is worth more. Cold, heat, rain, snow, darkness and climbing all raise your multiplier, measured on our servers from where and when you actually ran.
• Milestones: points for distance covered, a bonus for every week of your streak, and permanent trophies for your first 5K, 10K, half and full marathon.
• Territory Decay: ground you don't re-run slowly fades and releases. Consistency beats one heroic land grab.
• Landmarks: bonus points for looping around parks, monuments, museums and capitols. Either everyone can claim each place once, or only the first runner there gets paid.

SEASONS AND TROPHIES
A group sets its own season length — monthly, quarterly, yearly, or open-ended. When a season closes, the top three take home permanent trophies, and the map opens as unclaimed ground. Every past season keeps its own frozen board and map.

SEE EXACTLY WHY YOU SCORED
Tap any score for a full breakdown: the ground you're holding, what each active rule added, and the total.

BUILT TO BE FAIR
Scoring rules are set by Territor.io, never by group owners, so nobody can tune the game in their own favor. Weather, elevation and daylight are looked up server-side, so nothing your phone reports can inflate a score. Runs at impossible speeds are rejected.

YOUR PRIVACY
A run stays private to you until you choose to publish it. Other players see your username, your color and the shape of the loops you've published but never your real name, email or photo. We don't store the raw point-by-point GPS trail of your run on our servers, only the boundary of the loop you claimed.

STEAL & DEFEND
Territory is never safe. Run through a rival's zone and take it for yourself — but watch your back, because they can take it right back.

Run. Capture. Conquer. Your city is waiting.

Venrun turns your everyday walk or run into a conquest.

Run a loop - any loop, anywhere - and the ground you enclosed becomes yours. The moment your route closes, you see it happen: the map fills in, in your color, before you've stopped running.

WHAT COUNTS AS A CONQUEST

Only closed loops. Distance earns you nothing and neither does pace — a slow two-kilometer loop around three blocks takes ground that a fast twenty-kilometer out-and-back never will. Venrun rewards where you run, not how hard.

HOLD WHAT YOU TOOK

Territory softens if you leave it alone, and eventually slips away. Run through it again and it hardens. Ground you've covered over and over becomes your heartland: other runners can push into it, but they can't simply take it from you.

NEIGHBORS

The map is shared. When another runner claims ground near yours, you hear about it. When one of their loops cuts into your territory, you know. You never see anyone's route - only the ground they hold.

LANDMARKS

Parks, bridges, monuments and stations carry titles. Hold the ground around one and the title is yours, along with a record of how long you kept it.

BRING YOUR HISTORY

Already have runs in Apple Health? Import them and claim ground you covered weeks ago. New workouts import on their own after that.

NO SCOREBOARD, NOTHING TO BUY

There are no points to grind, no subscription and no purchases. What you have is ground, and the only way to get more is to go outside and run around it.

Whom does INTVL help?

Doctors and health professionals
INTVL is ideal for the medical field, covering some of the most widely used statistics and definitions in medicine and health research.

Academics
INTVL helps you deal with reporting bias in the academic literature by generating insightful statistics that are often not reported, in a flash.
Use it to review other studies or for your own projects (some of our calculators and converters are not readily available in many renowned computer software).

Scientists and researchers
Its calculators are powerful and accurate enough to perform various scientific calculations and probably most research applications you can think of.

Students and junior researchers
Its friendly and informative UI makes it great to get a better understanding of core statistical and mathematical concepts and learn how to correctly interpret some of the most widely used statistics in applied research.


What do you get with the paid version?

Eleven statistical calculators and converters, with more on the way!
- Confidence interval (CI) calculators for major statistics used in primary studies and meta-analyses.
- Prediction interval (PI) generators for meta-analyses results.
- P value to confidence interval converters.

Top-of-the-line glossary based on authoritative sources, including over 200 interlinked definitions in various fields, including medicine, statistics, and mathematics.

Free updates with new calculators, converters, definitions, and features.

No in-app ads, not now, not ever.

No data collection


Key features

- Easy to use

- Fast

- Accurate

- Informative



An edge in research

CIs for proportions
Unlike crude proportions, CIs offer information about the precision of the estimate and the population from which the sample was drawn. 

CIs for means
Similar to proportions, crude means do not say anything about precision or the population and mental calculations of a CI using a standard deviation or standard error (if reported) may be inconvenient and will not be as precise as when using a calculator.

P values to CIs
Unlike a p value, a CI can be more than a simple indicator of statistical significance and give you clues about the precision of an estimate and family of alternatives in the short term or about the size and direction of the effect in the long run.

PIs to assess heterogeneity in meta-analyses
- The CI of a pooled effect estimate is like an average of averages and does not tell us how the true effect size varies across populations and, therefore, how much heterogeneity exists in a meta-analysis. 
- The p value for the Chi squared test only tells us if there is or is no significant heterogeneity;
- The I squared statistic only tells us what percentage (%) of the variance we observe is due to heterogeneity;
- The Tau and Tau squared statistics give us an indication in regard to the amount of heterogeneity present but may be very inconvenient to use in mental calculations.

Compared to the above statistics, PIs can reveal the amount of heterogeneity more directly and, at the same time, tell us how significantly it impacts the estimation.

Probably the best glossary in the world for statistical intervals
We have reviewed some of the world's most authoritative sources to build a highly consistent vocabulary that includes well-defined inter-linked definitions.
